question: Does training across multiple years, with or without recency weighting, improve the fixed continuous-age model?
weight_normalization: sum of weights equals n of latest training cohort (year-4) to keep effective L2 penalty comparable
fixed_model: same categorical+continuous age spline, LR C1 seed7 max_iter2000
comparison: single-year continuous_age_result; compare uniform and recent separately, never select per evaluation year
limits: Repeated permits across annual training cohorts are longitudinal observations, not unique independent stores.
Reused evaluation periods, retrospective experiment; no untouched test claim.
Every training outcome ends before calibration; calibration outcome ends before evaluation.
No random sampling, no tuning after results, no app or database update.
